messages:
maria: FinBank raised two blockers in the security review: SCIM bulk provisioning throttle (they need ~50k users initial sync) and SSO failover — they want SP-initiated fallback to a backup IdP + domain proofing. Any quick mitigations we can propose?

alex: For SCIM bulk we can suggest a one-time S3-based bulk import if they allow it, otherwise delta sync with a larger page_size and exponential backoff. Do we have a documented throughput number they can expect? :thinking:

maria: They quoted 400 req/s sustained for ~10 minutes during onboarding. They're worried rate limits will cause 503s and break the user import job.

julie: I can run a synthetic 50k user sync POC against Dedicated to demonstrate throughput and failure modes. Need a signed DPA for data-in-transit/storage if we go via S3 import. I can also show SCIM retry headers and recommended backoff patterns. Available Tue/Wed next week.

sam: Security checklist notes: they require signed SAML assertions (SHA256), audience strictness, optional assertion encryption, and session timeout of 8h. They also want SCIM audit logs exported to their SIEM (S3/HTTP syslog/webhook). I'll fill those sections in the questionnaire.

maria: Can someone paste a minimal SAML SP metadata snippet to share with their IdP eng team? They asked specifically for ACS URL, logout URL, and cert fingerprint.

julie: quick example for their IdP engineer: ```xml
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://redwood.example/sp">
  <SPSSODescriptor AuthnRequestsSigned="true">
    <AssertionConsumerService Location="https://api.redwood.ai/saml/acs" Binding="HTTP-POST"/>
    <SingleLogoutService Location="https://api.redwood.ai/saml/slo" Binding="HTTP-Redirect"/>
  </SPSSODescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>
```
Include the x509 cert and SHA256 fingerprint in the metadata block.

alex: For domain proofing we support email domain claims plus DNS TXT or cert-based verification. DNS TXT is easiest for them to automate; certificate proofing is available for enterprises that want to tie an mTLS cert to tenant ownership. We also support tenant pinning to prevent takeover.

maria: Pricing concern from procurement: will a heavy SCIM onboarding spike incur extra Hosted charges? Need a quick Hosted vs Dedicated estimate for the 50k sync and sustained 400 rps over 10m.

ken: FYI Sales Ops — Hosted billing would charge against API/ingest units during the run; that could be noticeable for a one-off. Dedicated can be quoted with a short burst reserve for onboarding traffic which is often cheaper for big spikes. I'll draft a quick TCO (hosted run cost estimate vs Dedicated burst quote) and post by EOD tomorrow.

sam: One more functional ask: they need RBAC group mapping from SCIM enterprise apps to internal roles, including nested groups. We support group->role mapping via attribute mappers; nested group expansion is supported behind the "expand_groups" flag but we should validate on their dataset because performance varies. Add this to the POC test plan.

maria: Plan agreed: (1) Julie runs POC synthetic sync on Dedicated to prove throughput and SCIM retry behavior; (2) Sam completes sec questionnaire answers and shares with FinBank security; (3) Ken drafts Hosted vs Dedicated cost delta; (4) Alex prepares final SAML metadata + domain proofing doc. Target: EOD Friday for internal artifacts so we can update the customer.

julie: I will queue the POC and post logs/results here. @sam — can you confirm acceptable audit log export formats for the customer?

sam: I can provide S3 (Parquet/JSON), syslog (RFC5424), or webhook JSON payloads. Will attach sample schema in the questionnaire. Also will note retention and access controls (KMS).

deploy-bot: POC job started: job_id=poc-1715502468-1 status=queued node_pool=Dedicated-small

maria: Thanks everyone — I'll update the buyer and mark legal for the S3/import DPA option. Follow-ups: julie to share run results, ken to post cost delta, sam to upload questionnaire answers. :thumbsup:
